name: Kubernetes client config (kube-state)
description: Owns the kubeconfig for the Kubernetes tools in the image (kubectl, velero, kustomize, argocd, ...): sets KUBECONFIG=/var/lib/devcontainer-features/kube-state/config and mounts a named volume on /var/lib/devcontainer-features/kube-state, so a kubeconfig imported once survives rebuilds and no repo hand-mounts ~/.kube. Installs no kubectl itself (add ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/kubectl-helm-minikube before it if you want one). Adds a post-create hook (kube-state-setup) that makes the directory usable by the remote user, keeps the kubeconfig private to it, and reports whether a kubeconfig and a current context are present. Plus the Feature Taskfile.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

restrictPermissions.description: At post-create, chmod the kubeconfig file to 0600 when it exists (kubectl and helm warn about a group- or world-readable one; it holds credentials). Override per container with KUBE_STATE_SETUP_RESTRICT_PERMISSIONS in containerEnv.
